The three install paths now agree on what version they installed.

`go install github.com/thousandflowers/canary/cmd/canary@latest` printed
`canary dev` while Homebrew and the one-liner printed the release number. The
version is stamped through ldflags at release time, and a plain `go install`
has no flags of ours to stamp with.

The module version was inside the binary the whole time. `canary version` now
falls back to `debug.ReadBuildInfo().Main.Version` when nothing was stamped, so
a go-installed binary reports the release it was built from. A local `go build`
still says `dev`, because its build info says `(devel)` and that is true.

Nothing else changed: no new behaviour, no new flags, same bird.
